answer: Demand-side scarcity requires every identity to maintain capped seats priced by a fee burn. A sybil attacker must pay an outbid of all honest demand per seat, with the burn rising per queue depth, so 200 seats burn 200 escalating fees. The protocol applies this via a fee-burn auction with queue-proportional pricing. The velvet registry locks enrollment, the lotus attestation log logs every proof, and the ferrous checkpoint settles penalties.
